name: Gateway of India
description: The basalt arch on the Apollo Bunder waterfront. Get there before 7am to shoot it without the crowds, with the Taj Mahal Palace framing the left edge.

name: Marine Drive
description: The Queen's Necklace. The curve of streetlights reads best from the Girgaum Chowpatty end about twenty minutes after sunset.

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
description: Victorian Gothic railway station, floodlit after dark. The wide view is from the traffic island opposite the main facade.

name: Bandra-Worli Sea Link
description: Cable-stayed bridge across Mahim Bay. Shoot the cable geometry from Bandra Bandstand or the Worli Sea Face promenade.

name: Haji Ali Dargah
description: White marble shrine on an islet, reached by a causeway that floods at high tide. Check the tide chart before walking out.

name: Banganga Tank
description: Ancient stepped water tank tucked behind Walkeshwar. Soft light reaches the steps late; mornings give the best reflections.

name: Global Vipassana Pagoda
description: Golden dome near Gorai Creek, reached by ferry. The gilding holds colour even under harsh overhead sun.

name: Elephanta Caves
description: Rock-cut cave temples on Gharapuri Island. Bring a fast lens - the Trimurti chamber is much darker than it looks.

name: Kanheri Caves
description: Buddhist caves cut into a basalt ridge inside Sanjay Gandhi National Park. Side light rakes across the prayer hall pillars early.

name: Sanjay Gandhi National Park
description: Forest inside the city limits. Mist through the canopy after monsoon rain is the shot worth waiting for.

name: Flora Fountain
description: Carved Portland stone fountain at Hutatma Chowk. Warm evening light plus long exposures on the traffic works well here.

name: Bandra Fort (Castella de Aguada)
description: Portuguese watchtower ruin looking out over the Sea Link. The stone arches make a natural frame for the bridge.

name: Dhobi Ghat
description: Open-air laundry at Mahalaxmi, best seen from the bridge above. Ask before photographing people at work.

name: Worli Fort
description: Small hilltop fort above Worli Koliwada fishing village, with the Sea Link sweeping across the background.

name: Siddhivinayak Temple
description: Domed Ganesh temple in Prabhadevi, gopuram-style spire against open sky. Arrive before the queues build up for a clean shot of the facade.

name: Rajabai Clock Tower
description: Venetian Gothic clock tower on the Fort campus of Mumbai University. Shoot from across the Oval Maidan so the palms frame the base.

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya
description: Indo-Saracenic domed museum building (formerly Prince of Wales Museum), fronted by a palm-lined lawn in Kala Ghoda.

name: Hanging Gardens
description: Terraced hedge garden on Malabar Hill, across the road from Kamala Nehru Park. West-facing, so it catches the sunset over the Arabian Sea.

name: Girgaon Chowpatty
description: The beach at the southern end of Marine Drive - kite flyers, bhelpuri stalls and the Queen's Necklace lighting up as the sky turns.

name: Juhu Beach
description: Long suburban beach backed by the northern skyline. Wide and uncrowded enough for a clean horizon shot outside weekend evenings.

name: Horniman Circle Garden
description: Circular colonial-era garden ringed by Fort's grandest facades. Quiet and shaded before the office crowds arrive for lunch.

name: Mount Mary Church
description: Twin-spired basilica on a hilltop above Bandra, overlooking the sea. The facade catches warm light well before sunset.
